taxonomy_summary: Platypus koryoensis (Murayama, 1930). Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus koryoensis
taxonomic_history.note: Published generic usage verified in the monograph p.219.

taxonomic_history.name: Crossotarsus koryoensis
taxonomic_history.note: Original account pp. 28–30; original name and description verified.

nomenclature_note: Original combination Crossotarsus koryoensis (Murayama, 1930:28–30) and subsequent Platypus usage (Schedl, 1972:219) are verified; the earliest transfer has not been established. Korean old galleries without beetle specimens do not establish a verified host.
